behemoth.subtitle: Awaken the bloodline · March into enemy empires · Cross-server war

overview.bigPictureBody: Two servers clash, Behemoth vs Behemoth. Earn Awaken Runestones to grow ours, then invade the enemy while defending our own. Highest total score wins — but both sides earn Behemoth Crystals, so play even from behind.
overview.bigPictureCallout: Three ways to score: cultivate ours, defend ours, attack theirs. Spend Behemoth Crystals before the event ends — during Stellar Dynasty, trade them for Conquest Points instead.

taming.goal1: Earn Awaken Runestones daily and donate them to grow our Behemoth before the invasion.
taming.goal2: Donating tips Bloodline Purity our way and earns 10 personal points per runestone.
taming.schedulePtr: 📅 The daily Trial of Scion schedule is on the Overview tab (also reachable via the 🦄 badge in the header).

primordial.title: PRIMORDIAL CONFLICT
primordial.subtitle: Four-Kingdom Round-Robin · Special KvK (No Troop Loss)

header.workshopBefore: The Order Workshop event opens on Battle Day 1 (Tue Oct 13, 19:00 UTC)
header.workshopAfter: The Battle Stage is complete — Order Workshops have closed

overview.structureP1: A 4-server round-robin KvK. Three days of 1v1 battles (Days 2–4) where you face each opponent once, then a battlefield selection by the leading kingdom (Day 5), a 4-way showdown (Day 6), and partial troop recovery (Day 7).
overview.coreLoop: Core Loop — During battle days you earn Primordial Dew by gathering at Alchemy Pools and fighting over Order Workshops. Each day's 1v1 has two workshop events — one on each server (3 workshops each). Dew converts to Primordial Points for scoring. On the showdown day, Essence Refineries appear around the chosen Imperial City; holding them generates Primordial Essence and massive Kingdom Points.

points.gatheringBody: For every 100 Personal Primordial Dew gathered, you earn 10,000 Personal Primordial Points. Workshop-participation Dew (30K) does not generate points.
points.combatBody: Combat scores only when the tier difference is ≤ 2 (T9 vs T7 counts, T9 vs T6 does not). Points scale by enemy unit tier. In this no-troop-loss cycle, wounded units recover — combat carries no lasting cost.
